title: El Ladrillo de Tecate, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: ladrillo-tecate (MAJESTIC): ladrillera artesanal en Tecate, Baja California. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.CLEMENTE_ARCE: Mexican man from Baja California, brickmaker, 72 years old, tall and thin, sunburned light-brown skin, thin white hair, a short white beard, a faded denim long-sleeve shirt with dry clay dust, beige canvas trousers, a wide straw hat, worn boots, his hands empty.
chars.TEOFILO_MEDINA: Mexican man, 45 years old, strong build, brown skin, short black hair with grey temples, a thick black mustache, calm intense eyes, a worn grey long-sleeve work shirt with dry mud stains, old jeans, work boots, a plain faded green cap with no logo, his hands empty.
chars.SANTIAGO_DELVALLE: Mexican man, 33 years old, light skin, styled light-brown hair, a trimmed beard, a light-blue linen shirt, white chinos, a brown leather belt, an expensive watch, brown loafers, aviator sunglasses hanging on his shirt, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_LADRILLERA: Artisan brick kiln yard in Tecate, Baja California, in the late afternoon: rows of fresh adobe bricks drying on the ground, tall stacks of red fired bricks, a big old brick kiln with a dark mouth and light smoke, a mud pit with wooden molds, dry rocky hills with boulders behind, golden dusty light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
